name: Copy.ai
description: Copy.ai describes itself as "The First AI-Native GTM Platform," a unified system meant to replace disconnected AI copilots across sales, marketing, and operations.
best_for: Copy.ai positions itself for go-to-market teams — sales (prospecting, lead processing, deal management), marketing (content, ABM, localization), and operations (lead intelligence, CRM enrichment) — as a replacement for fragmented point-solution copilots.
features: Copy Agents for automated guardrailed workflows

alternatives.name: Jasper
alternatives.description: A marketing-specific AI agent platform with strong brand-governance tooling, narrower than Copy.ai's full GTM scope.
alternatives.best_for: Marketing teams prioritizing brand consistency and content pipelines.

alternatives.name: ChatGPT
alternatives.description: A general-purpose AI assistant usable for GTM writing tasks.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting a flexible assistant rather than a dedicated GTM automation suite.
